name: ConvertRebarDataToDesignSectionFormat
formula: =LAMBDA(layerArr,rebarArr,startArr,endArr,LET(locationArr, DROP(SORT(UNIQUE(VSTACK(startArr, endArr))), 1), comment1, "Filter rebar of certain lo", output, IN_StripRebar!{ref}ForLoop(1, ROWS(locationArr), LAMBDA(i, LET(cLoc, INDEX(locationArr, i, 1), filterBoolTop, REGEXTEST(layerArr, "T") * (cLoc > startArr) * (cLoc <= endArr), filterBoolBot, REGEXTEST(layerArr, "B") * (cLoc > startArr) * (cLoc <= endArr), filterBoolLink, REGEXTEST(layerArr, "link") * (cLoc > startArr) * (cLoc <= endArr), topRebar, TEXTJOIN("+", TRUE, FILTER(rebarArr, filterBoolTop, "-")), topLayers, TEXTJOIN(",", TRUE, FILTER(layerArr, filterBoolTop, "-")), botRebar, TEXTJOIN("+", TRUE, FILTER(rebarArr, filterBoolBot, "-")), botLayers, TEXTJOIN("+", TRUE, FILTER(layerArr, filterBoolBot, "-")), links, TEXTJOIN("+", TRUE, FILTER(rebarArr, filterBoolLink, "-")), HSTACK(topLayers, topRebar, botLayers, botRebar, links)))), HSTACK(locationArr, output)))
